## Summary

What problem does this change solve?

## Scope

What changed, and which files or components are affected?

## Evidence

Link the issue, source files, discussion, and duplicate search used to justify the change.

## Validation

List exact commands and observed results. Mark checks that were not run as **not run**.
Link CI runs when available.

## Risks and follow-up

List known risks, unanswered questions, or remaining maintainer actions.

## Maintainer checklist

- [ ] The change addresses a confirmed, in-scope problem.
- [ ] The diff is limited to the stated scope.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, private prompts, or unnecessary personal data are included.
- [ ] No legal attestation or personal representation is being made on another person's behalf.
- [ ] Keep this pull request in draft until a human maintainer approves readiness.
